outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: SIX original painted battle-animation poses in TWO columns THREE rows with broad empty gutters. Input image is original identity and EXACT weapon-design authority. Same lean rugged Icehook Trapper man: brown hair, offwhite fur-lined coat/hood down, blue scarf and inner split cloth, gray trousers, brown harness/bracers/fur winter boots, rope coil and steel cable loop on belt. RIGHT hand ALWAYS retains ONE short steel icehook with blue-wrapped grip, curved crescent forward blade and small rear spur exactly as reference; LEFT hand stays empty. Keep blade shape/size/material throughout, not an axe, not an icicle or knife. Elevated three-quarter camera faces RIGHT, same body scale. Top-left: attack windup, right elbow draws hook beside right shoulder, left hand balances ahead, both feet planted. Top-right: attack contact, right shoulder and elbow drive hook in a forward/downward sweep across body toward screen RIGHT; entire curved blade visible just beyond left forearm, left open hand pulled back safely, bent knees and rear toe support. Middle-left: attack recovery, right elbow draws the SAME hook back low beside right hip, left hand returns to ready, torso straightens. Middle-right: guard-ready, both feet planted, right hook held diagonally across chest, free left forearm raised behind the blade clear of its edge. Bottom-left: grounded walking contact, near/right boot reaches forward toward RIGHT and touches heel, far/left leg behind toward LEFT touches toe; weapon carried safely low. Bottom-right: next passing pose, near/right boot planted under hip supports body, far/left knee advances with lifted boot just clear of ground. No airborne support, same equipment and face, complete blade/rope/boots with large margins. Original painterly raster on uniform pure green #00FF00 background without spill/shadow. No grid, text, scenery, speed effects, blood, extra hands or new weapons.
